command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/skyrl-venv/bin:$PATH
mkdir -p /workspace/qwen35-grpo
cd /workspace/qwen35-grpo
export PYTHONPATH=/workspace/qwen35-grpo:/workspace/src:/workspace/vendor/SkyRL:/workspace/vendor/SkyRL/skyrl-gym
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 SKYRL_PYTHONPATH_EXPORT=1

export VLLM_DISABLE_PYNCCL=1 VLLM_ALLREDUCE_USE_SYMM_MEM=0

/opt/skyrl-venv/bin/python -c 'import boto3,hashlib,io,tarfile,json
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path
s3=boto3.client('"'"'s3'"'"',region_name='"'"'us-west-2'"'"')
b=s3.get_object(Bucket='"'"'scale-ml'"'"',Key='"'"'tmp/mohamedelfeki/scaletrain/qwen35-grpo-v2/payloads/payload-ba7ee87db5c80cca0dc518be4ee3b0a93cd483dcb564b48e31b7e759af021f2f.tar.gz'"'"')['"'"'Body'"'"'].read()
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()=='"'"'ba7ee87db5c80cca0dc518be4ee3b0a93cd483dcb564b48e31b7e759af021f2f'"'"'
tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b),mode='"'"'r:gz'"'"').extractall('"'"'.'"'"',filter='"'"'data'"'"')
Path('"'"'assets/model'"'"').mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def fetch(record):
 p=Path('"'"'assets/model'"'"')/record['"'"'name'"'"']
 s3.download_file('"'"'scale-ml'"'"','"'"'tmp/mohamedelfeki/scaletrain/qwen35-grpo-v2/model/'"'"'+record['"'"'name'"'"'],str(p))
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with p.open('"'"'rb'"'"') as f:
  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b'"'"''"'"'):h.update(block)
 assert h.hexdigest()==record['"'"'sha256'"'"'],record['"'"'name'"'"']
with ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as pool:list(pool.map(fetch,json.loads(Path('"'"'assets/model-manifest.json'"'"').read_text())))
